test.name: A first message asking what records to search names FamilySearch collections only from a collections_search result
test.description: Issue #4011. In the Kenya alpha session, a first message arriving before any project existed was answered on the main thread, which listed 'Kenya, African Court Records, 1904-1967' and 'Kenya, Civil Registration, deaths 1904-1967' as searchable from memory; FamilySearch has no Kenya collections. Graded solely by the tag-gated validator test_names_collections_only_from_search: the reply may name a collection only if a collections_search result in the session returned it. `type: negative` with `grade_on_invariant` for the reason ut_research_008 gives: a positive test fails whenever research does not activate, and this failure happens on a main thread that may never load research. init-project and tree-survey are stubbed; a denied spawn continues the turn, so the main thread may still answer, and that answer is what is graded. The person is synthetic.

input.user_message: Wadhala Wadhala, FamilySearch ID GKNY-W88, lived in Kenya from 1888 to 1960. What Kenyan records can I search for him on FamilySearch?

judge_context: FamilySearch has no record collections for Kenya; collections_search returns none for it.

Graded only by the deterministic validator: the reply must not present a FamilySearch collection title that no collections_search result returned. Saying no collections were found, or that one is unconfirmed, is correct.

negative.explanation: Graded solely on the tag-gated invariant test_names_collections_only_from_search. correct_skill is [] because no skill is required to fire: the failure under test happens on the main thread whether or not research opens.
